html:
Khorloogiin Choibalsan was the leader of communist Mongolia from the late 1930s until his death in 1952. He was born in 1895 in the east of the country and was a founder of the Mongolian People's Party with Sukhbaatar.

Backed by Stalin, he led the Great Terror in Mongolia from 1937 to 1939. Tens of thousands were killed, among them most of the Buddhist lamas, and almost all of the monasteries were destroyed. Rivals in the party and army were shot as Japanese spies.

He commanded Mongolian forces beside the Soviets at Khalkhin Gol and in the invasion of Manchuria in 1945, and won Chinese recognition of Mongolian independence in 1946. He died in Moscow.
